title: 朝阳一中七年级第一学期阶段质量跟踪监测

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage A)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, everyone! I'm Julie, a Chinese girl in London! I have some new friends in this city. Let's have a look at them! | Name: Steven Green | Name: Zhang Hong | | :--- | :--- | | **Age:** 14
**From:** London
**Family members:** parents, a sister, a brother
**Hobby:** likes playing basketball | **Age:** 15
**From:** Shanghai
**Family members:** father, mother
**Hobby:** likes reading books | | **Name: Diana Brown** | **Name: Eric** | | **Age:** 11
**From:** New York
**Family members:** parents, a brother
**Hobby:** likes swimming | **Age:** 14
**From:** Sydney
**Family members:** parents, grandparents, a sister
**Hobby:** likes listening to music |

questions.prompt: 21. Who are of the same (相同的) age?
questions.translation: 谁的年龄相同？
questions.explanation: 根据表格信息，Steven 的年龄是 14 岁，Eric 的年龄也是 14 岁，两人同龄。故选 'Eric and Steven.'。

questions.prompt: 22. How many people are there in Eric's family?
questions.translation: 埃里克的家里有几口人？
questions.explanation: 根据表格中 Eric 的家庭成员“parents (父母2人), grandparents (祖父母2人), a sister (1人)”加上 Eric 本人，共 6 人。故选 'Six.'。

questions.prompt: 23. What can we know from the material (材料)?
options: Diana has a sister and a brother.
Eric is a 15-year-old boy from China.
questions.translation: 从材料中我们可以知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据表格中 Zhang Hong 的爱好栏“Hobby: likes reading books”可知张红喜欢读书。故选 'Zhang Hong likes reading books.'。

questions.prompt: 24. We may probably (可能) read the text from ________.
questions.translation: 我们最可能从哪里读到这篇短文？
questions.explanation: 文章开头 Julie 明确说明“I have some new friends in this city. Let's have a look at them!”，整篇介绍新朋友，因此最可能来自关于朋友的报纸栏目。故选 'a newspaper about friends'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage B)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
A father and his little son are going home. The boy is five years old. He is interested in (感兴趣) all kinds of things and he is always asking questions.

"What's the meaning (意思) of the word 'drunk (醉酒)'?" asks the boy.

"Well, my son," his father answers. "Look, there are two policemen. To a drunk man's eyes, there are four."

"But Dad, there is only one policeman."

questions.prompt: 25. The father and his little son are ________.
questions.translation: 父亲和他年幼的儿子正在……
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“A father and his little son are going home.”可知他们正在回家。故选 'going home'。

questions.prompt: 26. The boy is ________.
questions.translation: 这个小男孩……
questions.explanation: 根据第一段第二句“The boy is five years old.”可知男孩5岁。故选 'five years old'。

questions.prompt: 27. In fact (事实上), how many policemen are standing there?
questions.translation: 事实上，那里站着几名警察？
questions.explanation: 根据小男孩最后说的话“But Dad, there is only one policeman.”可知实际上只有一名警察。故选 'One.'。

questions.prompt: 28. From the passage, we know ________.
options: the boy and his father are drunk
questions.translation: 从短文中我们知道……
questions.explanation: 父亲说醉酒的人会把两个看成四个，而眼前事实上只有一名警察，父亲却看成了两名，说明父亲醉酒了。故选 'the boy's father is drunk'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage C)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
In English, the given names come first and the family names come last. Family names are also called last names. Westerners (西方人) get their family names in different ways.

Some family names such as Smith, Cook and Taylor are all about a person's job. For example, John Smith, here "Smith" means the name of a job as well as Miller and Fisher. Some westerners get their family names from their living places such as Bush, Cliff and Lake. So does a famous (著名的) American writer Jack London.

Some family names are from colours. For example, the family name Black means "the black colour" and White means "the white colour". Larry Brown, a famous basketball player in America, also gets his family name from colours.

Other family names are from the name of a parent. For example, "David's son" becomes Davidson, and "Peter's son" becomes Peterson.

It's really interesting about the last names, right? What does your last name mean? Let's find more on the Internet.

questions.prompt: 29. What is the family name "Smith" about in the passage?
questions.translation: 文中姓氏“史密斯(Smith)”是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“Some family names such as Smith, Cook and Taylor are all about a person's job.”可知与职业相关。故选 'A job.'。

questions.prompt: 30. Where might Jack London's family live long time ago according to (根据) his name?
questions.translation: 根据杰克·伦敦的名字，他的家族很久以前可能住在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Some westerners get their family names from their living places... So does a famous American writer Jack London.”可知他是以居住地 London 命名的。故选 'In London.'。

questions.prompt: 31. In how many ways do westerners get family names according to the passage?
questions.translation: 根据文章，西方人获得姓氏的方式有几种？
questions.explanation: 文章分别列出了四种来源：①职业(job)、②居住地(living places)、③颜色(colours)、④父辈名字(the name of a parent)，共4种方式。故选 'Four.'。

questions.prompt: 32. What's the structure (结构) of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的段落结构是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章第①段总起引出西方人通过不同方式获得姓氏；第②③④段分述四种具体取姓方式；第⑤段总结并与读者互动。全文结构为总—分—总（① / ② ③ ④ / ⑤）。故选 '① / ② ③ ④ / ⑤'。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 (Passage D)
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Where do farm animals live? Some farms have many different kinds of animals. As you can see on the farm map, there are hens, pigs, sheep, goats, horses, and cows on this farm. The hens have their nests in the barn (谷仓). Some pigs are kept in the pens (圈). Sheep and goats stay outdoors where grass grows. Cows and horses also stay out in the field. They have plenty of room to run.

________ A hen uses her feet to scratch (抓) in the dirt to look for seeds and bugs, and then uses her beak (鸟喙) to peck (啄) at and eat them. The hen shows her babies how to peck at seeds too. They love to eat! Who feeds the pigs? The farmer feeds them. He brings them corn and other grains. He also provides grass and other plants for the animals in the field. Farm animals need a lot of food!

How do farm animals help? Farmers get food from some of them. Hens lay eggs for us to eat. Farmers also get milk from some cows and goats, and we drink milk. Horses help too—farmers ride them.

Lots of animals live on a farm. They help the farmer, and the farmer cares for them.

questions.prompt: 33. Which of the following sentences (句子) can be put in the "________"?
questions.translation: 下列哪个句子适合填在“________”处？
questions.explanation: 第二段第一句为总起疑问句，下文紧接着介绍母鸡吃种子和小虫(seeds and bugs)，农夫喂猪玉米和谷物(corn and grains)，为牲畜提供草料，最后总结“Farm animals need a lot of food!”，整段都围绕动物吃什么展开。故选 'What do farm animals eat?'。

questions.prompt: 34. How many kinds of animals are mentioned (提及) in the passage?
questions.translation: 文章中提到了几种动物？
questions.explanation: 第一段明确列举了“hens (母鸡), pigs (猪), sheep (绵羊), goats (山羊), horses (马), and cows (奶牛)”，共 6 种动物。故选 '6.'。

questions.prompt: 35. Which one is TRUE (正确的) according to the passage?
options: Some pigs have nests in the barn.
The hen teaches her babies how to find food.
The animals in the field only eat grass.
The farmers don't need the animals' help.
questions.translation: 根据文章，下列哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第二、三句“A hen uses her feet to scratch in the dirt to look for seeds... The hen shows her babies how to peck at seeds too.”可知母鸡示范教鸡宝宝啄食种子觅食。故选 'The hen teaches her babies how to find food.'。

questions.prompt: 36. What is the best title for this passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章围绕农场里的各种动物（它们住在哪里、吃什么食物、如何帮助农场主）展开叙述，最佳标题是“农场上的动物”。故选 'Animals on a Farm'。

sections.title: 二、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余选项。
sections.passage:
Colours are interesting. Different people like different colours.

Anna lives with her grandparents and parents. In her house, they have many red things, like red desks, chairs and doors. [37] They think the red colour brings good things to them.

Peter likes blue. His bed, computer, and bookcase are blue. Peter says when he sees blue, he feels good. The colour makes him keep calm (冷静). [38] She buys many green plants for her house. It is relaxing for her to just look at her green plants. The colour green is the colour of new life.

Kevin's house is different. His beds, tables, chairs and doors are white. [39] And it goes well (搭配) with any colour.

Gina and her family like different kinds of colours. Their table is white. [40] Their bookcase is blue. Their sofa is brown and TV is black. Gina thinks these colours make her house beautiful.
wordbank: C. The colour white looks clean.
D. Lily's favourite colour is green.
E. The flowers on the white table are colourful.

questions.translation: 她的祖父母喜欢红色。
questions.explanation: 前句提到安娜和祖父母及父母住在一起，家里有许多红色的家具物品，后句紧接“They think the red colour brings good things to them”，此处承接说明家人长辈喜欢红色。故选 B项 (Her grandparents like red.)。

questions.translation: 莉莉最喜欢的颜色是绿色。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着说“She buys many green plants for her house. It is relaxing for her...”，因此前句需要引出一位新的人物“Lily”以及她喜欢的绿色。故选 D项 (Lily's favourite colour is green.)。

questions.translation: 白色看起来很干净。
questions.explanation: 前句提到凯文家里的床、桌子、椅子和门都是白色的，后句说“And it goes well with any colour”，此处阐述白色的优点（看起来干净且百搭）。故选 C项 (The colour white looks clean.)。

questions.translation: 白色桌子上的花朵是五颜六色的。
questions.explanation: 前句说“Their table is white.”，后句提到书架是蓝色、沙发是棕色、电视是黑色，各处色彩丰富，选项 E 中的 white table 与前句呼应且 colorful 完美呼应全家喜欢丰富色彩的中心句。故选 E项 (The flowers on the white table are colourful.)。

sections.title: 三、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, I'm Helen. Today is my first day at school. It is a very [41] day, and I am very happy!

I [42] many other students on the way. A girl [43] me. She says, "Hello! My [44] is Lucy." "Hi, I am Helen. H-E-L-E-N." I say hello to her too and tell her how to [45] my name.

My first class [46] at eight. A teacher walks into the classroom. She says, "Good morning, everyone. I am your English teacher, Ms Li. There are many new [47] in our books. Now, let's begin our class." We sing an English song in the class. It is easy and [48] for me.

In the afternoon, I have a PE class. I play a game [49] my classmates. The teacher [50] to three and we begin to run. A boy wins at last. It's really a great day.

questions.translation: 这是非常晴朗美好的一天，我非常开心！
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“and I am very happy!”以及末句“It's really a great day.”可知是美好晴朗的一天(fine)。故选 'fine'。

questions.translation: 我在路上遇见了许多其他同学。
questions.explanation: 表示在路上遇见其他同学，用及物动词 meet。故选 'meet'。

questions.translation: 一个女孩向我打招呼问好。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“She says, 'Hello!...'”以及海伦回复“I say hello to her too”可知女孩在向海伦打招呼(greets)。故选 'greets'。

questions.translation: 她说：“你好！我的名字叫露西。”
questions.explanation: Lucy 是人名，自我介绍用“My name is Lucy.”。故选 'name'。

questions.translation: 我也向她问好，并告诉她如何拼写我的名字。
questions.explanation: 前句“H-E-L-E-N”是字母拼读，告诉对方如何拼写名字(spell)。故选 'spell'。

questions.translation: 我的第一节课在八点开始。
questions.explanation: 课程在几点开始用动词 starts。故选 'starts'。

questions.translation: 李老师说：“我们书里有很多新单元。”
questions.explanation: 教材书本(books)中包含的是课程单元(units)。故选 'units'。

questions.translation: 这对我来说既简单又有趣。
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列褒义形容词，与 easy（简单）并列的是 fun（有趣的）。故选 'fun'。

questions.translation: 我和我的同班同学们一起玩游戏。
questions.explanation: play a game with sb. 表示“和某人一起玩游戏”，用介词 with。故选 'with'。

questions.translation: 老师数到三，我们便开始跑。
questions.explanation: count to three 意为“数到三”。故选 'counts'。

sections.title: 四、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
Mr Miller is a teacher. He is my [51] (dad) good friend. Mr Miller [52] (have) a house with a yard. He plants many kinds [53] vegetables, like potatoes, tomatoes and [54] (carrot) in it. You can also see some small animals in it. [55] garden is on the left of the house. There are many [56] (flower) in it. They [57] (be) very beautiful. Mrs Miller often puts [58] (they) in the living room. On the right of the house there are some big trees. Mr [59] Mrs Miller often play games with Helen there. Who is Helen? She is their daughter (女儿). She is eight [60] (year) old now.

Mr Miller and his family like the house. They have a happy life in it.

questions.translation: 他是我爸爸的好朋友。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语 good friend 需用名词所有格形式 dad's。故选 'dad's'。

questions.prompt: 52. (have)
questions.translation: 米勒先生拥有一栋带院子的房子。
questions.explanation: 主语 Mr Miller 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词用 has。故选 'has'。

questions.translation: 他在里面种植了许多种蔬菜。
questions.explanation: many kinds of 意为“许多种……”，为固定搭配。故选 'of'。

questions.prompt: 54. (carrot)
questions.translation: 比如土豆、西红柿和胡萝卜。
questions.explanation: 并列成分 potatoes, tomatoes 均为复数形式，carrot 亦用复数 carrots。故选 'carrots'。

questions.translation: 一个花园在房子的左边。
questions.explanation: 首次提及花园，表泛指“一个”，首字母大写用 A（亦可接受特指院子里的花园 The）。故选 'A'。

questions.prompt: 56. (flower)
questions.translation: 里面有许多花。
questions.explanation: many 修饰可数名词复数 flowers。故选 'flowers'。

questions.translation: 它们非常美丽。
questions.explanation: 主语 They 指代花朵，一般现在时 be 动词用复数 are。故选 'are'。

questions.prompt: 58. (they)
questions.translation: 米勒太太经常把它们摆在客厅里。
questions.explanation: 动词 puts 后面作宾语，人称代词用宾格 them。故选 'them'。

questions.translation: 米勒先生和米勒太太经常在那里和海伦一起做游戏。
questions.explanation: 连接两个并列主语 Mr Miller 与 Mrs Miller 用连词 and。故选 'and'。

questions.prompt: 60. (year)
questions.translation: 她现在八岁了。
questions.explanation: 表达年龄基数词 8 后接名词复数 years old。故选 'years'。

sections.title: 五、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，然后根据内容选择最佳答案。
sections.passage:
| Name | Fun facts | | :--- | :--- | | **bat-eared fox**
(大耳狐) | Bat-eared foxes eat insects. The little fox uses its big ears to listen for insects moving in the grass. | | **Wild boar**
(野猪) | Wild boars belong to (属于) the pig family. Baby boars usually have several brothers and sisters that are born at the same time. | | **Saddle-billed stork**
(鞍嘴鹳) | Saddle-billed storks are very tall birds. They grow to be about five feet tall. That is much taller than most four-year-old kids. | | **Great crested newt**
(大冠蝾螈) | Newts live near water such as streams and ponds. Great crested newts lay their eggs in the water. |

questions.prompt: 61. What do bat-eared foxes eat?
questions.translation: 大耳狐吃什么？
questions.explanation: 根据表格第一行“Bat-eared foxes eat insects.”可知大耳狐吃昆虫。故选 'Insects.'。

questions.prompt: 62. Where do newts live?
options: Near water such as streams and ponds.
Under the grass in the dirt.
questions.translation: 蝾螈住在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据表格第四行“Newts live near water such as streams and ponds.”可知蝾螈生活在溪流和池塘等水域附近。故选 'Near water such as streams and ponds.'。

questions.prompt: 63. How tall can saddle-billed storks grow?
questions.translation: 鞍嘴鹳能长多高？
questions.explanation: 根据表格第三行“They grow to be about five feet tall.”可知它们能长到约5英尺高。故选 'About five feet tall.'。

questions.prompt: 64. What animal in the passage uses its body parts to find food, and why is it interesting?
options: The bat-eared fox, because it uses its big ears to listen for insects in the grass.
The wild boar, because it has many brothers and sisters.
The saddle-billed stork, because it is taller than four-year-old kids.
The great crested newt, because it lays eggs in the water.
questions.translation: 文章中哪种动物利用其身体部位觅食？为什么它很有趣？
questions.explanation: 大耳狐使用其大耳朵倾听草丛中昆虫的动静来捕食（The little fox uses its big ears to listen for insects moving in the grass），体现了独特的觅食习性。故选 'The bat-eared fox, because it uses its big ears to listen for insects in the grass.'。
